name: Ferienhaus Neuegg
beschreibung: The Ferienhaus Neuegg is situated in a quiet, sunny hillside location in the Tiroler Unterland with a view of the surrounding mountain range. The immediate surroundings are characterized by forest and agricultural land. The nearest ski area and the village center can be reached by car in just a few minutes. The amenities include a modern kitchen, a fireplace in the living area, and several bedrooms. The accommodation offers space for up to eight guests. The quiet location and functional furnishings make the house a suitable accommodation for families and hikers.
